objects.taxonomy_description: A portable rectangular container with a handle and hinged lid, designed for carrying personal items.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a rigid, box-like structure with defined rectangular or square dimensions.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Closure_Mechanism: A visible hinge line or seam divides the object into two distinct halves that open like a book.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Carrying_Apparatus: A sturdy handle is attached to the top or side, distinguishing it from bags with soft straps.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Rigidity: The exterior maintains a fixed geometric form without sagging, indicating a hard-shell or structured frame.

objects.taxonomy_description: Brass wind instrument with compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape. Length approximately 33 cm. Bell flares to 11-12 cm diameter, facing forward. Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with mother-of-pearl or plastic finger buttons. Mouthpiece is cup-shaped, detachable, inserted into leadpipe. Body surface is lacquered brass (golden-yellow) or silver-plated (bright white-metal). Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell. Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines. Bell rim is rolled edge. Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.
